paper_title: Inhomogeneous Energy Injection in the 21-cm Power Spectrum: Sensitivity to Dark Matter Decay
notes: This is a methods + Fisher-forecast paper. It introduces the DM21cm simulation framework for spatially inhomogeneous exotic energy injection into the 21-cm signal, and in Sec. IV performs a Fisher forecast projecting the sensitivity of upcoming HERA 21-cm power-spectrum measurements to DM decay (to photons and to e+e-), quoted as projected bounds on the DM decay lifetime tau (~10^28 s) vs DM mass. These are projected/forecast constraints, not a measured exclusion, and the observable is a decay lifetime rather than any of the canonical couplings. Reported as a projection with no data points.
